mapper.select: SELECT u.useremail AS email , u.password AS password , u.username AS username , u.nickname AS nickname , u.birth_date AS birthDate , u.gender AS gender , u.bio AS bio FROM users u WHERE u.useremail = #{email}
SELECT prt.id AS id , prt.token AS token , prt.email AS email , prt.expires_at AS expiresAt , prt.used AS used FROM password_reset_token prt WHERE prt.token = #{token}
